review:
A 10-line Egyptian book slot with two free spins rounds. The golden book is wild and scatter, as you'd expect.

You can hit regular Free Spins or the stronger Super Free Spins, both with multipliers that grow as the round goes on – a nice upgrade on the standard book formula. Chance x2 doubles your bonus odds for a slightly higher bet. High volatility, a 10,000x max and a 97% RTP. Free spins land about once every 197 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
